Game Overview

Dragon Rider Viking puts players into a adventure experience centered on embark on a daring quest through the Forest of Doom alongside a fearless Viking and his dragon ally. Master strategic combat, wield an eclectic arsenal, and unleash fiery attacks as you evade traps and uncover ancient secrets. Will your skills and bravery outwit this shadowy realm's lurking dangers?
